name: io.github.802-Flamingo/farmhouse-chocolates
title: Farmhouse Chocolates
description: Vermont-made chocolate gifts: live prices, gift ideas, shipping dates, allergens, stockists.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the Farmhouse Chocolates online shop (handmade in Bristol, Vermont): chocolate-covered salted caramels, dark chocolate truffles, organic 2 oz chocolate bars and gift bundles. Returns live retail prices in USD, availability and the product page URL. Leave the query empty to list everything.

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. "maple truffles", "salted caramel", "gift set"

max_price.description: Only products with a price at or under this, in USD

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full details for one product: description, ingredients, allergen statement, storage and shelf life, the choices offered at checkout (flavor, size), and each size with its price and availability. Pass the handle or URL from search_products.

handle.description: The product handle (e.g. "chocolate-covered-caramels") or its full product URL

tools.name: recommend_gifts
tools.description: Gift ideas from Farmhouse Chocolates for a budget, occasion and diet: Vermont-made holiday and Christmas gifts, stocking stuffers, host and thank-you gifts, birthdays, client gifts. Every suggestion is a real product at its live price, gift-wrapped with a handwritten note, shipped to all 50 US states.

budget_max.description: Most to spend on one gift, in USD

budget_min.description: Least to spend on one gift, in USD

diet.description: vegan or dairy_free returns only our vegan dark bars

recipients.description: How many people get a gift

tools.name: get_store_info
tools.description: Verified answers about Farmhouse Chocolates: shipping rates and times, holiday order-by dates, allergens (gluten-free, nut-free kitchen, vegan bars), storage and shelf life, ingredients and sourcing, gift wrap and notes, corporate gifts, wholesale, pickup and visiting Bristol, melted or damaged orders, contact. Each answer cites the page it comes from.

tools.name: find_stores
tools.description: Shops, cafés and markets that carry Farmhouse Chocolates, from our public Where to Buy map. Search by town, state or shop name, and/or near a latitude and longitude. Stock varies; suggest calling the shop first.

query.description: Town, state, ZIP or shop name, e.g. "Burlington VT"

radius_km.description: With latitude/longitude: how far to look (default 40 km)
